name: Confirm WooCommerce COD Orders via WhatsApp Polls and Send Order Updates with Supergreen

parameters.content:
## Confirm WooCommerce Cash-on-Delivery (COD) orders via WhatsApp polls and automate order updates

### How it works

1. Listens for new WooCommerce orders, places Cash-on-Delivery (`cod`) orders `on-hold`, and sends a 3-option native WhatsApp confirmation poll via Supergreen — no Meta template approvals or free-text reply parsing.
2. Captures real-time poll votes to release confirmed COD orders to `processing` in WooCommerce, flag address changes to Slack fulfillment, or auto-cancel declined COD orders before you waste shipping fees.
3. Sends instant WhatsApp confirmations for prepaid orders and dispatched updates whenever an order transitions to `completed`.
4. Runs a 2-hour sweep to remind buyers who have not tapped the COD poll after 4 hours and notifies Slack ops.
5. Captures any unhandled runtime errors via Error Trigger and posts alerts to Slack.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Install the `n8n-nodes-supergreen` community node and connect your WhatsApp line at [supergreen.cc/n8n](https://supergreen.cc/n8n?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=woocommerce-cod-polls).
- [ ] Add credentials for **WooCommerce API**, **Supergreen API**, **Google Sheets OAuth2**, and **Slack OAuth2**.
- [ ] Create a Google Sheet with a `WooOrders` tab containing columns: `orderId`, `orderNumber`, `customerName`, `phone`, `total`, `items`, `address`, `paymentMethod`, `status`, `pollMessageId`, `reminderDueAt`, `reminderSent`, `updatedAt`.
- [ ] Replace `SET_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`, `SET_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID`, and your store name across the configuration nodes and Slack error node.
- [ ] Verify your WooCommerce Cash-on-Delivery gateway slug matches `cod` (or update `codPaymentMethod` in Store Configuration).

### Customization

Adjust `codReminderHours` (default 4) or swap Google Sheets for Airtable or Postgres, and localize poll options into your store's language.

## 1. Capture and normalize WooCommerce orders

Listens for order.created webhooks, deduplicates retries, loads store settings, and extracts E.164 phone, address, and COD status.

## 2. Split COD vs prepaid orders

Checks whether payment_method matches your Cash-on-Delivery method to route confirmation polls separately from prepaid orders.

## 3. Hold COD order and send WhatsApp poll

Puts COD orders on-hold in WooCommerce, sends an interactive 3-option confirmation poll via Supergreen, and stores pollMessageId in Sheets.

## 4. Confirm prepaid order immediately

Sends an instant WhatsApp receipt for prepaid orders and records them as Confirmed in Google Sheets.

## 5. Match poll vote to pending COD order

Triggers on real-time Supergreen vote events and looks up the matching WooCommerce order by pollMessageId in Google Sheets.

## 6. Validate vote and route decision

Ignores unvotes or already-resolved orders and routes confirmed, address-change, and cancelled selections down dedicated branches.

## 7. Release confirmed COD order for shipping

Updates WooCommerce order status to processing, marks Confirmed COD in Sheets, and notifies the customer on WhatsApp.

## 8. Hold order for shipping address fix

Flags Address Requested in Sheets, alerts fulfillment in Slack, and asks the buyer on WhatsApp to reply with the corrected address.

## 9. Auto-cancel declined COD order

Cancels the order directly in WooCommerce before dispatch, updates Google Sheets, and sends a confirmation message on WhatsApp.

## 10. Detect completed WooCommerce shipments

Listens for order.updated webhooks, filters for status=completed, and deduplicates notifications per order.

## 11. Send dispatched notice and update sheet

Notifies the buyer on WhatsApp when their parcel ships and marks the row Completed in Google Sheets.

## 12. Find overdue unconfirmed COD orders

Runs every 2 hours to find Pending COD rows past their reminder window that have not received a follow-up yet.

## 13. Follow up and alert ops on stalled COD

Sends a WhatsApp nudge referencing the poll, marks reminderSent=Yes in Sheets, and alerts Slack ops for manual review.

## 14. Alert Slack on workflow errors

Catches unhandled workflow failures via Error Trigger and posts the failing node and error message to Slack.
